announcements.headline: Extension of Exclusivity Agreement
announcements.insight: Following the proposed acquisition and suspension announced in September, this extension delays the process. Shareholders should watch for the next court meeting or sanction date.

announcements.headline: Unaudited interim results to 31 July 2026
announcements.insight: Interim results precede a proposed acquisition and listing suspension. This sequence suggests an imminent change of control or delisting event for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Proposed Acquisition and Suspension of Listing
announcements.insight: Milton Capital faces proposed acquisition and suspension of listing. Shareholders must monitor this significant corporate action closely.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results. This follows the January 2026 audited accounts.

announcements.headline: AUDITED ACCOUNTS TO 31 JANUARY 2026
announcements.insight: Milton Capital has published its audited accounts for the year ended 31 January 2026. Shareholders should review the financial results to assess performance.
